title: An improved protocol for ex vivo expansion of highly lytic NK cells from human umbilical cord blood CD34<sup>+</sup> cells
protocol: Collect fresh cord blood from umbilical cords of full-term newborns.
Dilute collected cord blood samples 1:2 in PBS.
Isolate cord blood mononuclear cells by Ficoll-Hypaque centrifugation at 400 g for 30 minutes.
Wash isolated CBMCs extensively in PBS.
Isolate CD34+ cells from CBMCs using the Miltenyi human CD34 Microbead Kit.
Analyze cell purity by FACS; ensure purity is routinely higher than 90%.
Mix 10 μl of isolated cells with 80 μl of PBS and 10 μl of Trypan Blue.
Count viable CD34+ cells using a Neubauer chamber.
Culture isolated CD34+ cells in warm SCGM supplemented with Penicillin/Streptomycin and FBS.
Add recombinant human SCF, Flt3-L, IL-15, and IGF-1 to the culture medium.
Incubate cultures at 37°C in a humidified atmosphere with 5% CO2 for 4 weeks.
Replace half of the medium volume every 3–4 days with fresh medium containing the same concentration of freshly added cytokines.
Adjust cell density to 1×10^6 cells/ml in 6-well culture plates.
Collect cells at day 28.
Measure the percentage of CD3- CD56+ cells by FACS analysis.
Evaluate NK cell function through flow cytometry monitoring of perforin and CD107a expression.
Perform intracellular staining for perforin following surface staining for CD56+ CD3neg cells to identify NK cells.
Thoroughly resuspend cells with 250 μl of BD Cytofix/Cytoperm solution in the 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube and incubate for 20 min at 4°C.
Wash cells two times in 1 ml BD Perm/Wash buffer.
Thoroughly resuspend fixed/permeabilized cells in 50 μl of BD Perm/Wash buffer containing a predetermined optimal concentration of a PE-conjugated anti-perforin Ab or appropriate negative control.
Incubate at 4°C for 30 minutes in the dark.
Wash cells 2 times with BD Perm/Wash buffer.
Resuspend cells in staining buffer.
Analyze by flow cytometry.
Isolate cytokine-differentiated NK cells for CD107a assay.
Mix 2×10^5 NK cells and 2×10^5 K562 cells gently.
Spin down the mixture for 1 min at 200 g.
Incubate for 2 h at 37°C in 200 µl of SCGM media.
Stain NK cells with Alexa-647-labeled anti-CD56 antibody.
Stain NK cells with PE-Cy5-labeled anti-CD3 antibody.
Detect degranulation with PE-labeled anti-CD107a antibody.
